area: Classic campaign, fan and conversion completion
exitCriteria: Replay a winning route for every advertised Classic level, including the bundled fan corpus and conversions. Close the remaining Oh No! and Holiday routes. Verify continuous Full Quest progression, save/resume and final results. L2/L3 completion belongs to the sequel gate.
progress: After beta 29: official Classic coverage is 238/292 (54 missing), including the Oh No! Crazy 4 and 7 full rescues. Xmas 1992 is complete. Six new full-rescue routes are preserved. The retained 6,372-level corpus has 629 verified wins, no load/start failures and no lost wins; 5,743 identities still need winning evidence. There are 237 distinct hint replays and 177 full-rescue certificates. See Documentation/ClassicOneZero.md.

exitCriteria: Resolve provisional L3 tool, movement and trap semantics against original-engine evidence. Complete environmental effects, original movie audio and story transitions. Extend L2 original-engine comparisons. Record every L2/L3 winning route and verify continuous campaign progression, L2 survivor carry-over and endings.
progress: 64 L2 standalone routes remain preserved. Sixteen separately verified carry-over variants extend Egyptian to eight levels, Classic to five and Polar to four. Strict L2 completion now requires all twelve complete tribe chains. L3 has 17 recorded routes out of 90; its rules remain provisional. See Documentation/SequelClosure.md.

exitCriteria: Verify app and controller interruption on real hardware. Add versioned in-progress checkpoints and crash recovery before mobile suspend/termination support. Verify save migrations and rollback with real prior releases.
progress: Beta 25 passed both complete app journeys (32 checks each), including Classic/fan checkpoints, Hot Seat identity, paused handovers, retrying the previous level as the incoming player, replay journals, corruption, stale writers and safe solo transitions. Main-window ownership was fixed after validation exposed a delayed-refresh crash; close and refresh coverage now passes. Physical power-loss and installed-release migration trials remain open. See Beta25Readiness.md.

exitCriteria: Test the complete first-launch-to-results flow with physical Xbox, PlayStation and Switch-layout controllers. Add remapping and device glyphs, touch targeting, readable UI scaling, reduced motion/flash controls and VoiceOver navigation without forcing OG gameplay.
progress: Beta 25 passed complete software-driven journeys on Apple silicon and Intel/Rosetta. F retains the reached speed after release; mouse and keyboard speed arrows apply immediately from 1x. Green handover initials and the previous-level retry button were rendered and tested with real mouse events. Existing keyboard/controller routing, targeting, fonts, scalable menus, hints and interruption tests passed. Physical controllers and full VoiceOver remain unverified. See Beta25Readiness.md.

exitCriteria: Measure complete frame times, memory growth and audio under sustained 10x play, nukes, replays and repeated engine switches. Test physical Intel, minimum supported macOS, SDR/HDR, multiple displays and high refresh rates.
progress: 13 September: the performance audit now measures production asynchronous Metal submission, separately reports CPU work and GPU timing, rejects GPU failures, and verifies every encoded replay frame after finalisation. The clean M4 Pro/macOS 27 sample records 9.08× flat, 7.05× monitor and 6.92× television at requested 10×. All 5,932 captured frames are present in the movies. These short, silent Classic samples do not close sustained throughput, audio, native-sequel or hardware coverage. The earlier shared 500 ms encoder-stall bound remains tested. See ReleaseReadiness/PerformanceMeasurementClosure.md and ReplayStallClosure.md.

exitCriteria: Freeze the final source and assets. Build both Mac architectures, sign, notarise and verify the downloaded archive. Earlier beta notarisation is not evidence for later local builds.
progress: Beta 29 remains the notarised standard archive. Beta 30 Game Center packages the later closure work with an Apple Development signature and a profile for two registered Macs. Its extracted signature, resources and both architecture startups passed. It is not notarised. Live account checks and the final Classic 1.0 freeze remain open. See Documentation/Beta30GameCenterReadiness.md.

exitCriteria: Agree the proposed official product scope, brand use and asset distribution with the rights holder. Record code and asset provenance, third-party dependencies and approved distribution inputs. Obtain the required platform publishing access.
Validate first-play onboarding with novice players. Extend verified tiered hints beyond the original 120 levels and show supported mechanics clearly in imported packs.

Build and test the shared library with the iOS SDK. Implement a UIKit/Metal app shell, precise touch selection, safe-area layouts, audio/session interruptions, checkpoints, thermal budgets and device tests. A Package.swift deployment declaration is not an iOS app.

Use approved SDKs and hardware to establish the supported runtime and engine boundary. Implement native rendering, input, save/user services and suspend/resume adapters. Pass each platform's current requirements. Mac controller support is not a console port.

Validate Game Center on provisioned builds, network loss and offline records. Externalise product strings and verify layouts with translated text. Define platform account and cloud-save conflict handling.

Deliver an approved, reproducible demonstration build with a short feature tour, current evidence matrix, known limits, asset provenance and a platform delivery plan. Keep demonstration claims within verified scope.
